+

+
+def main():
+    s = Session("move_can_pot", instance=INSTANCE)
+    env = s.env
+    arm = env.arm_tag
+
+    print("initial can", env.can.get_pose().p, env.can.get_pose().q)
+    print("pot", env.pot.get_pose().p, "target", env.target_pose.p)
+    print("arm", arm, "initial success", env.check_success())
+
+    s.record_start()
+    ok_grasp = env.move(env.grasp_actor(env.can, arm))
+    print("grasp", ok_grasp, "plan_success", env.plan_success)
+    if not env.plan_success:
+        raise RuntimeError("grasp plan failed")
+
+    # RoboTwin's place helper keeps the can's model vertical axis aligned to the table
+    # normal and places its center at the task target beside the pot.
+    ok_place = env.move(
+        env.place_actor(
+            env.can,
+            arm,
+            env.target_pose,
+            pre_dis=0.10,
+            dis=0.02,
+            is_open=True,
+            constrain="free",
+        )
+    )
+    print("place", ok_place, "plan_success", env.plan_success)
+    if not env.plan_success:
+        raise RuntimeError("place plan failed")
+
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    print("after motion", s.status())
+    print("can final", env.can.get_pose().p, env.can.get_pose().q)
+    if not env.check_success():
+        raise RuntimeError("recorded motion did not satisfy check_success")
+
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / "trajectory.npz", meta={"arm": str(arm)})
+    replay = s.replay(actions)
+    print("replay", replay)
